name: Ultimate Mercy
text: Your mercy transcends the bounds of life and death. Add ultimate mercy to the types of mercy you can provide. When you use Mercy, you can target a creature that died since your last turn to return it to life. The target returns to life with 1 Hit Point and becomes Wounded 1. You can't return the target to life if it died from Disintegrate or a death effect. The creature gains the other benefits of Lay on Hands after it returns to life.
